svg.title: They follow by multiplying the inverse of I+E on the appropriate side, without commuting matrices. Absolute entry convergence permits each fixed multiplication and removal of the zeroth term. For Gs = I + s(A −I) invertible on [0, 1], factor it near r as [I + (s −r)(A −I)G−1 r ]Gr.
